en.p: For a constant $k$ and a cubic function $f(x)$ with $f'(0)=6$, the function
satisfies the following conditions. What is the value of $k+f\!\left(\dfrac{1}{2}\right)$? [4 points]

box: (A) For every real number $a$, the value of $\displaystyle\lim_{x\to a+}\frac{g(x)-g(a)}{x-a}$ exists, and that value is less than or equal to $0$.
(B) The maximum value of the real number $t$ for which the equation $g(x)=t$ in $x$ has exactly 2 distinct real roots is $13$.
